import subprocess
import json

LOG_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/log_actions.py"

    {"type": "goto", "target": "research", "metadata": {}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "Log Actions for Tick 61 (Corrected)", "metadata": {"eval_id": 143}},
    {"type": "goto", "target": "public_memory", "metadata": {}},
    {"type": "read", "target": "1,2,3", "metadata": {}}
]
actions_json_string_63 = json.dumps(actions_to_log_63)

subprocess.run(command_63, check=True)

# Log for Tick 64

    {"type": "goto", "target": "archive", "metadata": {}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "Log Actions for Tick 63", "metadata": {"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not available in Archive Room"}}
]
actions_json_string_64 = json.dumps(actions_to_log_64)
command_64 = ["python", LOG_SCRIPT_PATH, "64", actions_json_string_64]
subprocess.run(command_64, check=True)
